characterBible.prompt: Create an ORIGINAL character model sheet for an independent Traditional Chinese picture book for ages 7–9, 'Little Birds Beside the Line'. Pure WHITE paper, NO text, letters, labels, numbers, watermarks or props. FOUR separate full-body figures in FOUR equal columns, left to right: BOY YU front, BOY YU three-quarter; GIRL LIN front, GIRL LIN three-quarter. Same height, eight-year-old East Asian children, natural child proportions about 3.8 heads tall, all shoes visible, empty hands, no overlap. YU: black short SIDE-SWEPT hair with a tiny triangular forelock, gentle dark graphite eyes, OLIVE GREEN long-sleeve crewneck shirt with NO patches or logos, beige long trousers, deep plum-purple sneakers. LIN: straight chin-length BLACK BOB with softly curved ends, ONE BROAD MUSTARD fabric headband across top of head, no clips or braids; dusty ROSE PINK button-front smock over cream long-sleeve shirt, slate blue long trousers, white canvas shoes. Subtle warm pink cheeks and curious thoughtful expressions. ART DIRECTION: flat grey GRAPHITE PENCIL contours, lively dark graphite hair hatching, restrained COLORED PENCIL and dry pastel sage/rose/ochre/blue accents, slight white paper grain, huge airy white separation. Natural hands, expressive posture. NOT anime, not 3D, not photorealistic, no glossy gradients or dense painted background. Entirely original characters, no existing-character likeness.

illustrations.prompt: Original prop reference for a pencil-and-colored-pencil children's picture book. NO text, labels, numbers, letters or watermark anywhere. On a PURE WHITE wide landscape sheet, show THREE identical separate LANDSCAPE IVORY PAPER RECTANGLES side by side, generous space between, seen perfectly from above without perspective. Each paper contains the SAME naive child-painted tree: slightly curved brown trunk with three little roots, THREE rounded sage-green canopy lobes, open ivory space to right. No face, flowers, hearts or creatures. LEFT paper is the original tree only. MIDDLE paper repeats the exact tree but adds ONE bold thin BLACK DIAGONAL brush line rising from lower left toward upper right across the RIGHT SIDE of canopy, like an accidental stroke extending into blank space; NO birds. RIGHT paper repeats that SAME tree and SAME black diagonal line unaltered, with exactly TWO tiny SIMPLE SKY-BLUE BIRDS perched on that line and exactly TWO small green leaves near its right end. Birds are flat childlike crayon birds, not realistic or detailed animals. The black line is clearly visible before and after. Delicate graphite outlines, colored-pencil and childlike dry crayon tree, white-paper grain. No 3D or glossy paint. All three drawings identical in tree size and location; only the stated added stroke, then two birds and two leaves differ. No arrows, separators or printed stage markers.

Edit this original three-panel drawing reference. Keep LEFT and MIDDLE panels EXACTLY unchanged. Fix ONLY the BLACK DIAGONAL LINE and the two blue birds/two leaves in the RIGHT panel: the black diagonal in the right panel must have precisely the SAME steep upward-right slope, same starting point at trunk junction, same upper-right endpoint, length and thickness as the black diagonal in the MIDDLE panel. Currently the right diagonal is incorrectly flatter; raise its right endpoint to match the middle panel. Move the existing TWO sky-blue birds onto that corrected steep diagonal, and move the TWO little green leaves near its upper-right tip. Preserve the right panel's tree, paper rectangle, colors and every other detail. The narrative requires the accidental black stroke to remain completely unchanged when birds and leaves are added. No words, arrows, numbers, new birds or labels. Preserve pure white background and pencil texture.
